jobs.title: Legal Operations Intern
jobs.description: About H: H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential. H is hiring the world’s best AI talent, seeking those who are dedicated as much to building safely and responsibly as to advancing disruptive agentic capabilities. We promote a mindset of openness, learning, and collaboration, where everyone has something to contribute. About the Role: Our Legal team, based in Paris, supports every deal, hire and partnership at H. As requests grow, we want legal work to run on clear processes and good tools rather than on inboxes. You will be the front door for legal requests, run the contract lifecycle day to day, and above all build the tooling and automations that let the team move faster. You will report to our General Counsel. This is a 6 month internship, open to EFB (Barreau de Paris) students completing their PPI, or to recent graduates of an M2 in business law. Key Responsibilities: Tooling and automation (the core of the role): Map our existing legal processes and identify bottlenecks. Benchmark tools (contract lifecycle management, e-signature, request management) and deliver a costed recommendation. Build simple automations: intake forms, approval workflows, and Claude projects for first-pass contract reviews. Create a dashboard showing request volumes, turnaround times and active contracts. Front door for legal requests: Receive, triage and route internal requests (NDAs, customer contracts, vendors, HR). Set up and maintain a request tracker (Notion, Linear or similar) with status, priority and deadline. Follow up with internal and external stakeholders to keep matters moving. Contract lifecycle: Prepare first drafts from templates (NDAs, POCs, standard order forms), always reviewed by the General Counsel. Coordinate internal approvals with Sales, Finance and Engineering, and own our e-signature workflows from start to finis

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Specialist
jobs.description: The Compliance Specialist, EMEA is a subject matter expert who owns employment, labor, and statutory compliance across the region (primarily France, Spain, Portugal, Netherlands, Ireland and UK). This is an individual-contributor role where you will be the region s go-to authority on People compliance, partnering closely with People Operations, Legal, People Business Partners and regional stakeholders to build and maintain compliant people processes that enable Datadog s continued growth in EMEA. You ll join a growing team - currently a Compliance Coordinator and an incoming Apprentice joining in September - and will work closely with them, bringing a more experienced, hands-on perspective to help scale the team s compliance capabilities across the region. This is a hands-on, operational role suited to someone who enjoys working in the details, partnering cross-functionally, and building a strong foundation of People compliance across multiple countries. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture, the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work life harmony that best fits them.   What You ll Do: Own ongoing compliance with employment laws and regulations across EMEA, including tracking regulatory updates Own compliance oversight for employment contracts, health and safety in our offices Manage accommodation requests end-to-end Partner with People Operations and Legal to resolve compliance questions and mitigate risk Own compliance with statutory medical requirements in EMEA (requirements differ by country) Own statutory compliance obligations related to hiring employees with disabilities, including reporting duties Lead work rule updates, Works Council coordination (France and Netherlands), and reporting Own mandatory training compliance tracking and timely submission of required government reports Design, maintain, and evolve People policies

jobs.description: Our Mission Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve. About Brain Co. Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model. Why Now Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services. Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact. You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now. 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲 Brain Co is applying frontier AI to specialty insurance. We are building AI that reads specialty insurance policies — declarations, forms, endorsements, schedules of underlying, layered programs — and turns them into structured, decision-ready data. We need experienced specialty insurance underwriters/coverage attorneys/consultants/professionals to help us do it right. You will work directly with our engineering team: telling us where our AI falls short, annotating insurance documents, reviewing AI-generated output, and helping us build the rubrics and benchmarks that define quality for our machine learning pipelines. Your expertise shapes the product so it reflects how specialty insurance is actually practiced. We are looking for someone who can commit approximately 2–10 hours per week for an initial 3–4 months, with the opportunity to extend based on mutual interest and project needs. Across Appen's global delivery organization, you'll establish the workflows, expert requirements, quality standards, and operational blueprint needed to move successful pilots into scalable programs. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Legal Counsel PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk
jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
